title: umlimator map model
description: A layered architecture map: shared cards (nodes) and lines (edges), and views that each show some of them. Keys beyond these are allowed.

schemaVersion.description: 1 (or none): a map, read as always. 2: it may hold typed elements and typed views (docs/diagrams/model.md). A newer version is an error (0.17.0).

root.description: The view shown first (default: the view with no parent).

nodes.description: Every card, shared by the views.

edges.description: Every line, shared by the views: a view draws those between its cards.

icons.description: Icons by name, as render() draws them: g (an SVG group's inner markup, drawn in the card's colour) or src (an image URL or data URI).

sourcesBase.description: A prefix for the cards' source paths.

rules.description: What must hold: lines a rule forbids, or cycles between boxes. rules() lists what breaks them, the map marks it, and umlimator.py check fails on it.

stories.description: Narrated walk-throughs of the map: handle.play(id), the page's Stories menu, umlimator.py record.

lenses.description: Saved ways to look at the map: handle.lens(id), the page's Lenses menu and #lens=<id>. A lens lights what it picks and dims the rest; it never lays the view out again.

kind.description: The card's kind, drawn as its colour and mark. An unknown kind draws as a script card.

side.description: The card side the line uses.

id.description: Unique across the model, the view-local cards included.

badge.description: One tab on the card (badges takes several).

verbs.description: Chips on the card and in the details panel.

icon.description: A logo or line icon: a name from icons/manifest.json (render() draws what the model's icons table carries).

shape.description: The card's own shape (0.15.0): box, person, browser, mobile, cylinder, pipe, document, hexagon, robot, terminal, window, folder or node. Without it a map draws the card by its kind (a rounded box where no shape says more).

noSub.description: The name only on the card; the sub-line stays in the details panel.

opensView.description: The view the card opens. It may name a view the host loads only when it is opened. Schema version 2: the view a call behaviour action (an activity view), an interaction use or an inline interaction (a uml.sequence view) opens (0.21.0).

opensCount.description: The number on the ⤢ badge while the view it opens is not loaded.

owner.description: Who owns the card (a team, say): selectors pick cards by it, and a lens with color owner rings the card in its owner's tone.

change.description: A NEW, CHANGED, REMOVED or PLANNED badge; removed and planned cards are dashed.

what.description: The details panel's first tab. Markdown: `code`, **bold**, [links](https://…), blank-line paragraphs, - bullets.

when.description: When it happens. Markdown: `code`, **bold**, [links](https://…), blank-line paragraphs, - bullets.

how.description: How it works. Markdown: `code`, **bold**, [links](https://…), blank-line paragraphs, - bullets.

note.description: A note in the details panel.

source.description: Source paths (a :line suffix is fine), relative to sourcesBase.

author.description: A GitHub login: a name tag under the card.

origin.description: Where an external skill comes from.

credits.description: Further authors listed in the panel.

examples.description: A thumbnail gallery in the panel.

type.description: Schema version 2: the element's type, <notation>.<Name> (uml.Class). validate() checks typed fields only in a model with schemaVersion 2. The class diagram (uml.class, 0.18.0): uml.Class, uml.Interface, uml.Enumeration, uml.DataType, uml.PrimitiveType, uml.Package and uml.Comment; their members uml.Property, uml.Operation and uml.EnumerationLiteral. The object diagram (uml.object, 0.19.0): uml.InstanceSpecification and uml.Comment; an instance's members uml.Slot. The package diagram (uml.package, 0.19.0): uml.Package and the class diagram's classifiers, and uml.Comment. The sequence and communication diagrams (uml.sequence, uml.communication, 0.20.0): uml.Lifeline. The use case diagram (uml.use-case, 0.21.0): uml.Actor, uml.UseCase, uml.Subject and uml.Comment; a use case's members uml.ExtensionPoint. The activity diagram (uml.activity, 0.21.0): uml.InitialNode, uml.ActivityFinalNode, uml.FlowFinalNode, uml.Action, uml.CallBehaviorAction, uml.SendSignalAction, uml.AcceptEventAction, uml.DecisionNode, uml.MergeNode, uml.ForkNode, uml.JoinNode, uml.ObjectNode, uml.DataStoreNode, uml.ActivityPartition and uml.Comment. The state machine diagram (uml.state-machine, 0.21.0): uml.State, uml.Pseudostate, uml.FinalState and uml.Comment; a state's members uml.Region and uml.InternalTransition. The interaction overview diagram (uml.interaction-overview, 0.21.0): the activity's control nodes, uml.InteractionUse, uml.Interaction (an inline interaction) and uml.Comment.

parent.description: Schema version 2: the element that owns it (a package, a composite state, a lane). From 0.19.0 a class, object or package view draws a shown package that owns something it shows as a box holding it. A use case's: a subject or a package. An activity node's: its partition (lane); a partition's: the partition it is nested in. A substate's or pseudostate's: a state, or a region (a member) of one.

props.description: Schema version 2: the type's own properties. The class diagram (uml.class, 0.18.0): isAbstract and stereotypes on a classifier; on a member, the fields of its UML text (docs/conformance/uml-class.md). The object diagram (uml.object, 0.19.0): an instance's classifier and stereotypes; a slot's value (docs/conformance/uml-object.md). The sequence and communication diagrams (uml.sequence, uml.communication, 0.20.0): a lifeline's represents, and stereotypes (actor draws «actor» over its name). The state machine diagram (uml.state-machine, 0.21.0): a state's entry, do and exit, a pseudostate's kind (docs/conformance/uml-state-machine.md).

isAbstract.description: uml.Class, uml.Operation: true draws the name in italics ({abstract} in a member's text).

stereotypes.description: Any UML element: names drawn «in guillemets», as text (['entity']).

classifier.description: uml.InstanceSpecification: the name (or qualified name, sales::Order) of the classifier it is an instance of, as text; drawn name : Classifier, underlined.

represents.description: uml.Lifeline: what it is an instance of, by name, as text; drawn name : Type (docs/diagrams/risks.md M8).

entry.description: uml.State: its entry activity, as text; drawn as the row entry / text.

do.description: uml.State: its do activity, as text; drawn as the row do / text.

exit.description: uml.State: its exit activity, as text; drawn as the row exit / text.

kind.description: uml.Pseudostate: which pseudostate it is; any other is drawn as a junction, with a warning.

members.description: Schema version 2: owned parts, in display order (attributes, ports, regions, lanes), each a typed element. The class diagram (uml.class, 0.18.0): a classifier's attributes (uml.Property) and operations (uml.Operation), an enumeration's literals (uml.EnumerationLiteral). The object diagram (uml.object, 0.19.0): an instance's slots (uml.Slot), each a feature = value row. The use case diagram (uml.use-case, 0.21.0): a use case's extension points (uml.ExtensionPoint, by name). The state machine diagram (uml.state-machine, 0.21.0): a state's regions (uml.Region, by name) and internal transitions (uml.InternalTransition, trigger [guard] / effect).

items.description: A member: { id, type, label, props }, in the same envelope as a node.

id.description: Unique among every node, edge and member of the model.

type.description: uml.Property, uml.Operation or uml.EnumerationLiteral in a class diagram; uml.Slot in an object diagram. uml.ExtensionPoint in a use case diagram; uml.Region or uml.InternalTransition in a state machine diagram.

label.description: The member's name (a slot's: the feature it gives a value); the rest of its UML text is in props.

props.description: The member's UML text as fields: + {static} /total: Money [1] = 0.

isAbstract.description: uml.Class, uml.Operation: true draws the name in italics ({abstract} in a member's text).

stereotypes.description: Any UML element: names drawn «in guillemets», as text (['entity']).

visibility.description: uml.Property, uml.Operation: public, private, protected or package (+ - # ~).

valueType.description: uml.Property, and each of an operation's parameters: its type, as text (Money, String[], Map<K, V>).

multiplicity.description: uml.Property: 1, *, n..m or n..* (0..1, 1..*), kept as written.

default.description: uml.Property: its default value, as text.

isStatic.description: uml.Property, uml.Operation: true underlines it ({static} in its text).

isDerived.description: uml.Property: true writes / before its name.

parameters.description: uml.Operation: [{ name, valueType, direction }], direction in, out, inout or return.

returnType.description: uml.Operation: its return type, as text.

value.description: uml.Slot: its value, as text (34.00 EUR); left out, the slot is drawn by its feature's name.

trigger.description: uml.InternalTransition: what triggers it, as text (a trigger list, after 30 days).

guard.description: uml.InternalTransition: its guard, as text, drawn [in brackets].

effect.description: uml.InternalTransition: its effect, as text, drawn after /.

nodeOverride.description: This card's fields in this view only.

shape.description: The card's own shape (0.15.0): box, person, browser, mobile, cylinder, pipe, document, hexagon, robot, terminal, window, folder or node. Without it a map draws the card by its kind (a rounded box where no shape says more).

badge.description: One tab on the card (badges takes several).

verbs.description: Chips on the card and in the details panel.

icon.description: A logo or line icon: a name from icons/manifest.json (render() draws what the model's icons table carries).

noSub.description: The name only on the card; the sub-line stays in the details panel.

opensView.description: The view the card opens. It may name a view the host loads only when it is opened.

opensCount.description: The number on the ⤢ badge while the view it opens is not loaded.

owner.description: Who owns the card (a team, say): selectors pick cards by it, and a lens with color owner rings the card in its owner's tone.

change.description: A NEW, CHANGED, REMOVED or PLANNED badge; removed and planned cards are dashed.

what.description: The details panel's first tab. Markdown: `code`, **bold**, [links](https://…), blank-line paragraphs, - bullets.

when.description: When it happens. Markdown: `code`, **bold**, [links](https://…), blank-line paragraphs, - bullets.

how.description: How it works. Markdown: `code`, **bold**, [links](https://…), blank-line paragraphs, - bullets.

note.description: A note in the details panel.

source.description: Source paths (a :line suffix is fine), relative to sourcesBase.

author.description: A GitHub login: a name tag under the card.

origin.description: Where an external skill comes from.

credits.description: Further authors listed in the panel.

examples.description: A thumbnail gallery in the panel.

id.description: A line's id; views and events refer to it. Without one, a line is "<from>-><to>#<n>".

from.description: A card's id, or a box's id in the view: the line ends on its border.

to.description: A card's id, or a box's id in the view: the line ends on its border.

sublabel.description: A second, smaller line under the label (a technology, say); shown only with a label.

kind.description: What the line means, drawn as its colour (default calls).

weight.description: How much the line stands for, drawn as its width (default 1).

step.description: Its place in the order things happen: a number (2, or 2.1 for a step within step 2) or text of up to 3 characters (2a), drawn in a circle on the line in any view (a pill for 2 or 3 characters); a numbered view (render: sequence) numbers its lines in run order instead.

latency.description: How long the call takes, in ms: critical() sums it along a path. Not drawn.

cost.description: What the call costs, in any unit: critical() sums it along a path. Not drawn.

style.description: A style that wins over the kind's colour; faded keeps the kind's colour, faint and with no flow.

change.description: Drawn as an added or removed line; diff() marks a changed one edited.

drift.description: What drift() found: a line that carried traffic but was not drawn, or a drawn one that carried none.

loop.description: The view's loop back, whatever the cards' order.

what.description: The details panel. Markdown: `code`, **bold**, [links](https://…), blank-line paragraphs, - bullets.

type.description: Schema version 2: the element's type, <notation>.<Name> (uml.Class). The class diagram (uml.class, 0.18.0): uml.Association, uml.Generalization (from the specific to the general), uml.InterfaceRealization (to the interface), uml.Dependency (from the client) and uml.CommentLink (from the comment). The object diagram (uml.object, 0.19.0): uml.Link and uml.CommentLink. The package diagram (uml.package, 0.19.0): uml.PackageImport and uml.PackageMerge (from the importing or merging package), uml.Dependency and uml.CommentLink. The sequence diagram (uml.sequence, 0.20.0): uml.Message, inline in its view's edges, in time order. The communication diagram (uml.communication, 0.20.0): uml.Connector and uml.Message, model lines its view lists, connectors first; only the messages' order means anything. The use case diagram (uml.use-case, 0.21.0): uml.Association (an actor and a use case), uml.Include and uml.Extend (from the including or extending use case), uml.Generalization (from the specific to the general) and uml.CommentLink. The activity diagram (uml.activity, 0.21.0): uml.ControlFlow, uml.ObjectFlow and uml.CommentLink. The state machine diagram (uml.state-machine, 0.21.0): uml.Transition and uml.CommentLink. The interaction overview diagram (uml.interaction-overview, 0.21.0): uml.ControlFlow and uml.CommentLink.

parent.description: Schema version 2: the element that owns it (a package, a composite state, a lane). In a sequence view: the operand (uml.InteractionOperand) of one of its fragments that holds the message; none at the top level.

props.description: Schema version 2: the type's own properties. The class diagram (uml.class, 0.18.0): an association's ends, and stereotypes on any line («use» on a dependency). The object diagram (uml.object, 0.19.0): a link's association and the roles at its ends. The package diagram (uml.package, 0.19.0): a package import's visibility. The sequence and communication diagrams (0.20.0): a message's sort and replyTo. The use case diagram (0.21.0): an extend's extensionPoints and condition. The activity and interaction overview diagrams (0.21.0): a flow's guard (its label is its name). The state machine diagram (0.21.0): a transition's trigger, guard and effect, drawn trigger [guard] / effect.

ends.description: uml.Association: { from, to }, each end's role, multiplicity, aggregation and navigability. uml.Link: each end's role.

role.description: The role name, drawn by the end.

multiplicity.description: Drawn by the end: 1, *, n..m or n..*.

aggregation.description: none, shared (a hollow diamond at this end) or composite (a filled diamond; its multiplicity at most 1).

navigable.description: true draws an open arrowhead at this end.

role.description: The role name, drawn by the end.

multiplicity.description: Drawn by the end: 1, *, n..m or n..*.

aggregation.description: none, shared (a hollow diamond at this end) or composite (a filled diamond; its multiplicity at most 1).

navigable.description: true draws an open arrowhead at this end.

stereotypes.description: Any UML element: names drawn «in guillemets», as text (['entity']).

association.description: uml.Link: the name of the association it is an instance of, as text; drawn on the line when the link has no label.

visibility.description: uml.PackageImport: public (the default, drawn «import») or private (drawn «access»).

sort.description: uml.Message: call (the default), async, reply, create or delete; any other is drawn as a call, with a warning.

replyTo.description: uml.Message, a reply: the id of the earlier call it answers, which it goes back along.

extensionPoints.description: uml.Extend: the ids of the extension points (uml.ExtensionPoint members) of the use case it extends, at least one; drawn by name.

condition.description: uml.Extend: when it extends, as text; drawn [in brackets] after its points.

guard.description: uml.ControlFlow, uml.ObjectFlow, uml.Transition: its guard, as text, drawn [in brackets]; else is drawn [else].

trigger.description: uml.Transition: what triggers it, as text (M8: no event is parsed).

effect.description: uml.Transition: its effect, as text, drawn after /.

id.description: Unique in the view; a line may end on it.

nodeIds.description: The cards in the box; its child boxes come in by their parent.

parent.description: The box this one sits in.

tone.description: A tinted region behind the box, as a badge's tone names it (--um-<tone>): the box's border is dashed and its title in the tone.

id.description: Unique. A card with the same id opens this view.

parent.description: The view this one is inside (breadcrumbs, the up button).

edges.description: The lines this view draws: model line ids or lines of its own. Default: every model line between its cards; [] draws none. In a sequence view (uml.sequence, 0.20.0): its occurrences in time order, each message and interaction use inline, a fragment's operand by operand.

label.description: The interaction it refers to, by name.

parent.description: The operand (uml.InteractionOperand) that holds it; none at the top level.

covers.description: The ids of the lifelines it spans, next to each other in the view's nodeIds.

refersTo.description: The id of the view it refers to.

anyOf.description: Schema version 2: an occurrence of a sequence view that is not a line: an interaction use (uml.InteractionUse), its label the interaction it refers to, props.covers the lifelines it spans (next to each other in nodeIds), props.refersTo a view's id, parent its operand.

nodeOverrides.description: Cards' fields changed in this view only, by card id.

layout.description: Places set by hand: card id → [column, row] (halves allowed). Default: laid out automatically.

containers.description: Boxes around cards; parent nests them.

render.description: sequence: the lines are the run order, numbered. process: four to six bold, numbered steps.

stepIds.description: A process view's main steps; its other cards draw as tools.

lanes.description: Swimlanes: by hand, or false for none (a sequence view derives them).

tour.description: Cards a dot rides through, in order.

browserOrder.description: Views the view list shows first.

node.description: The card the view is about (default: the card with the view's id).

keepPairs.description: A→B and B→A drawn as two lines, not one two-way line.

repair.description: false: no port repair (a switch for debugging the router).

subAndChips.description: Cards 80 px tall that show their sub-line, then their chips.

kindsFromLabels.description: Guess a line's kind from its label's words when its edges name none (render() and layout(); the standalone page always does).

diagram.description: Schema version 2: the view's diagram type; without it the view is a map. uml.class draws a class diagram (0.18.0, lib/umlimator-all.js), uml.object an object diagram and uml.package a package diagram (0.19.0), uml.sequence a sequence diagram and uml.communication a communication diagram (0.20.0), uml.use-case a use case diagram, uml.activity an activity diagram, uml.state-machine a state machine diagram and uml.interaction-overview an interaction overview diagram (0.21.0); a type this release does not draw is drawn as plain cards, with a warning.

subject.description: Schema version 2: the element this diagram is the inside of. In a class, object or package view, the package names are qualified from (sales::Order without sales:: in a view of sales); not drawn unless the view lists it.

direction.description: Schema version 2: a typed view's layout direction (default right). A map stays left to right. A sequence view is always down; another direction is a warning.

notation.description: Schema version 2: a skin of the diagram type (crowsfoot for er).

present.description: Schema version 2: what the layout cannot derive, per element: collapsed compartments, rows shown before +n more.

additionalProperties.description: What a view shows of one element, by its id.

collapsed.description: Compartments not drawn, divider and all: ['attributes', 'operations'] (an enumeration's: 'literals'); a state's: 'activities' (its entry, do and exit and internal transitions, 0.21.0).

rows.description: At most this many rows in each compartment, then "+k more".

fragments.description: Schema version 2: a sequence view's combined fragments (uml.CombinedFragment, props.operator alt, opt, loop, par or break), outermost first; each one's members are its operands (uml.InteractionOperand, label the guard) in order, and its parent is the operand that holds it (uml.sequence, 0.20.0).

parent.description: The operand (uml.InteractionOperand) that holds it; none at the top level.

operator.description: The fragment's operator; any other is a warning.

timeline.description: Schema version 2: a timing view's unit, changes and constraints.

rule.description: No line from the cards `from` picks to the cards `to` picks (a side left out picks every card), or, with noCycles, no boxes that reach each other through their lines.

title.description: What the rule says, as its breaks name it: "Apps never call a database directly".

views.description: Narrows the views it holds in: by default every view, or, for a rule that names a box (a container, or a box's id, in from, to or a not), the views that draw one of the boxes it names.

from.description: The cards a forbidden line starts from.

to.description: The cards a forbidden line ends on.

noCycles.description: No boxes reach each other through their lines: a line counts between the two boxes that hold its ends right under the box (or view) they share.

selector.description: Picks cards: every key given must hold. A line's end on a box is that box: in it, and of no kind or owner.

kind.description: Cards by kind, as the map draws it: "db" picks databases.

container.description: Cards in these boxes, at any depth.

not.description: The cards this selector does not pick.

id.description: Unique among the stories: handle.play(id), and #story=<id> in a page's link.

title.description: The story's name, in the Stories menu and over its captions.

steps.description: What the story shows, in order.

storyStep.description: One step: it sets the whole picture (what it leaves out is cleared), then plays its tour.

caption.description: What the step says, in the caption bar and to screen readers.

select.description: The card or line selected: an id, or a Ref.

items.description: A card or line by id, or a Ref (as events name things).

highlight.description: Cards and lines lit, the rest dimmed: ids or Refs; the lines between two cards it names light too.

tour.description: Card ids: the path a dot rides, once the step is shown.

camera.description: Where the camera goes: "fit" (the default), a point and zoom, or a card to frame.

duration.description: The step's time in ms when playing (default 4000); its tour runs to its end first.

lens.description: A saved way to look at the map: what pick picks lit, the rest dimmed.

id.description: Unique among the lenses: handle.lens(id), and #lens=<id> in a page's link.

title.description: The lens's name, in the Lenses menu and over its legend.

pick.description: What the lens lights; left out, everything.

color.description: Rings each lit card in its owner's tone, with a legend.

lensSelector.description: A lens's pick: a rule's selector, and line kinds. Without line, the cards it picks lit, and the lines between two of them; with line, the lines of those kinds between two cards the rest of it picks, and their ends.

kind.description: Cards by kind, as the map draws it: "db" picks databases.

container.description: Cards in these boxes, at any depth.

not.description: The cards this selector does not pick.
